title: New Dashboard Home
body: The Dashboard Home page now shows a live overview of your tasks — stat cards, recent activity feeds, and a timeline chart. Click "Edit Dashboard" to customize which cards are shown.

title: Auto-Accept for CC Campaigns
teaser: See how the Accept CC Campaigns task finds and accepts opportunities automatically.
body:
The "Accept CC Campaigns for My Videos" task setup card walks you through pulling ASINs from your uploaded videos, checking Creator Connections for active and available campaigns, and optionally auto-accepting new opportunities without you lifting a finger.

Expired campaigns are kept around (with a red badge) instead of being deleted right away, so you can still see what you had until a new campaign shows up for the same product.

title: Rate limit presets retuned
body: The "Recommended" and "Fast" rate-limit presets are slower now, based on real runs that were getting throttled by Amazon almost instantly. You can still fine-tune them yourself in Settings.

title: Amazon Earnings Report task
teaser: A new guided setup for scheduling recurring earnings pulls, twice a day.
body:
The Add Tasks & Features page now has an "Amazon Earnings Report" card that walks you through setting up a recurring task: choose a date range, decide whether to fill in real product titles for each ASIN, and pick a twice-daily schedule.

A couple of tips: avoid scheduling a run exactly on the hour (Amazon's own reporting resets right around then), and if you want product titles filled in, point the wizard at the same collection your Clicks task already saves to — it'll reuse that data instead of doing extra work.

title: Per-task log buttons
body: Every task in the sidebar now has its own 📋 button — hover to preview the most recent run's log, click to copy it. The old single Copy Log button on the Reports page toolbar is gone.

title: Redesigned first-run setup
teaser: The welcome wizard now walks through every ID and connection step one at a time.
body:
First-run setup used to be 3 dense steps. It's now 7 focused ones with a progress bar: welcome, Base ID, Onsite ID, Shop ID, Storefront URL, YouTube channels, and a final confirmation.

The YouTube step can also auto-detect your channel if you have Creator Studio open in another tab, so you often won't need to paste anything in by hand.

title: Creator Connections status badges
body: Product rows now show a colored CC badge — green for active, blue for available, and red for expired (kept around for visibility, not deleted). Hover any badge for details.

title: First-task nudge
body: If you haven't created any tasks yet, the dashboard now shows a quick prompt pointing you to Add Tasks & Features so there's always a clear next step.

title: Customize your Dashboard Home
teaser: Add, remove, and reconfigure the stat and feed cards on your dashboard.
body:
Click "Edit Dashboard" to reveal a gear icon on every card (change what it shows) and a delete icon (remove it), plus a "+ Add Card" tile for adding new Stat cards (a single number, like Total Earnings or Clicks) or Feed cards (a short list, like Recent Clicks or this Announcements card).

Your layout is saved automatically and isn't tied to any specific task — it keeps working the same way whether you have one task or fifty.

title: Sidebar reorganized
body: Navigation is now grouped into Dashboard/Reports/Timeline/Earnings, Tasks & Setup, and Discovery, with Labs and Report Snapshots tucked into the footer.

title: Columns auto-collapse after a run
body: Empty columns now automatically hide themselves once a task finishes running, instead of only updating the next time you navigate away and back.

title: Video Ranker lab
teaser: An experimental tool for scoring your uploaded videos against each other.
body:
Labs now has a Video Ranker that pulls videos from a collection and scores them against configurable weights, so you can spot which uploads are most worth prioritizing for Creator Connections follow-up.

Like everything under Labs, this is experimental — expect it to change shape as we get more use out of it.

title: Opportunity Scout lab
body: A new experimental Labs tool for surfacing product opportunities worth investigating, based on your saved collections.

title: Amazon Pages setup wizard
teaser: A guided walkthrough for every Amazon Page Enhancement and International Uploading setting.
body:
Settings' Amazon Pages / International Uploading groups can now be configured through a 10-step guided wizard instead of a flat settings list, with an explanation for what each option actually does before you turn it on.

Find it from Add Tasks & Features → Amazon Page Enhancements.

title: Delete All Data fixed
body: Settings' Delete All Data button now correctly clears every collection and synced setting — it was silently failing to touch anything before.

title: Collections page
body: Browse every collection your tasks have saved to from one place — search, sort, and inspect individual records without needing to re-run a task.

title: Product Explorer
teaser: Discover new product opportunities outside of what your existing tasks already track.
body:
Product Explorer is a new Discovery page for browsing and searching Amazon products independently of your saved tasks — useful for scouting new items before you commit a task to tracking them.

Results here don't automatically get added to any collection; it's a research tool, not a data source for your tasks.

title: Welcome to Taipo
body: The extension has a new name and look — Taipo (Task AIP Operator). Same data, same tasks, new coat of paint.
